SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.TERM TERM, A.PFLSH PFLSH, A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, A.REMARK, A.HAP_CREDIT_AMT as hapCreditAmt, A.CREDIT_FLAG as creditFlag, C.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('03') left join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.SEQNO
A.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND A.VDATE >= to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.VDATE <= to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
